attribution.note: Marcus directly asserts the financial stakes.

semantics.note: The normalization preserves an observation about financial exposure, without predicting completed funding.

contract.note: The ordinary reading of substantial financial interests dependent on restructuring is fair. The contract's additional unknown-accounting-basis veto is inconsistent with the supplied plain-reading policy.

evidence.note: The disclosed restructuring-dependent funding terms described in the packet differ by USD 20 billion. This supports financial stakes at the claimed scale, as an investor disclosure of conditional commitments, not completed financing.

reviews.rationale: On the fair ordinary reading, the disclosed USD 20 billion difference between restructuring-dependent funding alternatives establishes tens of billions at stake. No inference about completed funding, revenue, or valuation is required.

reviews.rationale: The packet lacks the operative legislative text and evidence of applicability needed to settle the claimed legal obstacle. The original-introduction restriction also misrepresents the contextual statement. Neither support nor contradiction follows from these journal entries.
